postmortems.title: Scan latency increase detected
postmortems.rootCause: Garbage collection pause in scan worker
actionItems: Implement feature flag for rapid rollback capability
Add synthetic monitoring probe for early detection
lessonsLearned: Configuration changes need staged rollout validation

postmortems.title: Discord overlay false positive spike
postmortems.rootCause: Discord modified its overlay hook from SetWindowsHookEx to a direct IAT patch. Our kernel layer's DLL injection heuristic matched the new pattern.
actionItems: Implement additional monitoring for affected subsystem
Update runbook with new escalation procedures

postmortems.title: Behavioral model latency regression
postmortems.rootCause: New model architecture used unsupported ONNX operator on older CPUs, falling back to CPU-only path instead of using AVX2.
actionItems: Add hardware-matrix benchmarking gate to model deployment pipeline
Subscribe to ONNX Runtime release notes for breaking changes

postmortems.title: Driver load failure on Windows 11 24H2 preview
postmortems.rootCause: Microsoft changed kernel callback registration behavior in 24H2 preview build 26200. Updated driver to use version-aware callback registration.
actionItems: Subscribe to Windows Insider kernel change notifications
Add Win11 preview builds to CI test matrix
